intervalMeaning.E-real: predictive distribution of single replayed-year totals (one day-pool bootstrap + one synthetic year per draw)
intervalMeaning.E-exp: day-pool bootstrap of the mean of N_INNER replayed years per pool

S0_window_annualised_asLogged.note: naive annualisation of the logged window: every month draws from ALL window days (no exclusion), no temperature transform, no odometer calibration

S1_autumn_like_year.note: all months use the Sep-Nov day pool with the monthly normal ambient (untilted)

S2_balanced_owner_expected.note: PRIMARY: Jun-Aug summer pattern, May and Sep half and half, Oct-Apr autumn pattern, repo monthly normals, unlogged-distance factors, day draw tilted to the odometer lifetime mean

S2b_balanced_loggedBasis.note: as S2u without the unlogged-distance factors (logged distance only)

S3a_mild_winter.note: S2 with Dec-Feb +4 C (Nov, Mar +2 C)

S3b_cold_winter.note: S2 with Dec-Feb -6 C (Nov, Mar -3 C)

S3c_severe_winter.note: S2 with Dec-Feb -12 C (Nov, Mar -6 C)

S5_high_km_25k.note: S2 tilted to 25,000 km per year

S6_low_km_12k.note: S2 tilted to 12,000 km per year

S7_summer_like_year.note: all months use the May-Aug day pool with the monthly normal ambient (contrast case)
